purpose: Authored WebRTC / IPv6 / DoH judgement scenarios for the local canary test. Only synthetic candidates, synthetic addresses and contract-derived expectations are committed; no host telemetry, no captured traffic.

webrtc.rule: A candidate is direct unless it is typ relay; any UDP transport is non-proxied. An empty candidate set is inconclusive, never 'blocked'.

scenarios.meaning: A host candidate exposes a local address; non-proxied UDP is live.

sdp_like_entries: a=candidate:2 1 udp 1686052607 198.51.100.7 61234 typ srflx raddr 192.0.2.10 rport 54321
scenarios.meaning: A srflx candidate proves the browser reached a STUN server outside the proxy.
Default mDNS masking still signals a local UDP socket, so it is a direct candidate.

sdp_like_entries: candidate:4 1 udp 41885439 203.0.113.9 443 typ relay raddr 0.0.0.0 rport 0
scenarios.meaning: Every candidate is relay, which is compatible with disabled non-proxied UDP.
A gatherer that reports nothing cannot distinguish a working block from a broken UDP path.

ipv6.rule: Only a non-loopback IPv6 address observed at the peer is egress; loopback is not egress; no attempt is inconclusive.

doh.rule: Any of secure_dns_mode != 0, a configured DoH server, available secure transactions, or active DoT means DoH is a live bypass path. An unreadable configuration is inconclusive.

reconciliation.rule: A claim may only remain Declared when the observation supports it; there is no upgrade path from Unverified.
